artifacts.summary: Ten-phase plan landing gapPotential (U x U unfilled-pair ledger) with its density payment, identifyTime preservation, the MintPaysForTimeFixed refutation at .Dense/.RTime, a four-disjunct MintPaysForTimeGap discharged at every frame class, and a five-component measure carrying the terminus family.

memory_candidates.content: Termination-measure component design rule, rediscovered twice in the MintBound tableau-termination work: a measure component must transcribe the MONOTONE half of a rule's guard with its polarity inverted, never the guard's target set. Two instances: selfGuardDischarged (FormalSystem/.../MintBound/TimeReuse.lean) inverts untlNeg/snceNeg's non-empty-reach guard; gapFilled inverts densityRule's second filter conjunct ('no intermediate reaches t'). densityRule's guard has two conjuncts -- (i) t' is maximal, (ii) no intermediate -- and only (ii) is monotone. A ledger over the rule's own gap-TARGET set (which needs conjunct (i)) rises at ordinary steps, because any rule minting a fresh maximal time creates a new target; a ledger over FILLED pairs only falls, because edges are only added. Corollary for the identification arm: a component whose guard never reads a quantity the renaming can lower (here ord.timeCount) is preserved by reachability transport alone, with no extra hypothesis.
